thread:
Aisha: Heads-up: product asked us to run a 2-week SI onboarding cohort for marketplace + hw integration. need volunteers for curriculum + lab ops.
Connor: I can own curriculum outline. will focus on two tracks: Cloud marketplace publishing + HW acceleration integration.
Diego: I'll take lab ops — set up images, perf tests, and a runbook for mentors.
Priya: can marketing help with badges and co-branding? we should prepare a badge spec and announcement cadence. :sparkles:
Aisha: yes Priya pls coordinate badge artwork and the partner announcement timeline. tentative cohort dates: Jul 11-22. ok?
Connor: dates work. proposed syllabus: Day 1 intro + api hands-on, Day 2 marketplace packaging, Day 3 cert tests + lab prep, Week 2 SI-led customer workshop and shadowing.
Diego: infra checklist draft: base image (redwood/si-cohort:v1), sample model (rwd-small-1), load profile (2x5s concurrent, 300 tokens), KV cache enabled, observability hooks (trace + token metrics).
Priya: badge levels? Starter / Integrator / Certified Partner. Starter gets a digital badge + listing on our partner page, Certified Partner gets marketplace featured slot. need pricing approval for featured listing.
Aisha: loop in finance on featured listing pricing. Connor can you add a short lab rubric? we want pass/fail + notes.
Connor: Rubric: deployable (20), perf within SLO (40), integration tests pass (30), docs & runbook (10). pass >= 75. I'll put this in the shared doc.
Priya: marketing kickoff on Tue. I'll pull brand kit and make a 1-page partner benefits doc. also propose a joint blog + webinar on launch.
Diego: lab automation commands (for mentors):
```
# start isolated env
redwood-cli env create --name si-cohort-<si>-trial --image redwood/si-cohort:v1 --private
# deploy test model
redwood-cli deploy --env si-cohort-<si>-trial --model rwd-small-1 --quantize q4f16
# run perf
sie-run --target https://si-cohort-<si>-trial.redwood/api/generate --concurrency 2 --tokens 300 --duration 120
```
Aisha: good. question: how do we handle hardware partners for accelerated inference? do we require a validated HW image before cohort?
Diego: prefer validated images, but we can run a "compatibility day" before cohort where HW partners join to validate their AMIs.
Priya: badge copy draft: "Redwood SI Integrator — validated for Redwood inference runtimes and marketplace delivery." will post for review.
AzureMarketplaceBot: Note: Azure marketplace submission checklist has a 10-business-day review window. plan accordingly.
Aisha: action items:
- Connor: syllabus + rubric doc by Fri (1756930000)
- Diego: base images + runbook + test harness by Mon
- Priya: badge artwork + partner benefits page draft by next Wed
- Aisha: finance + legal looped for pricing and terms
Connor: scheduling mentors: recommend 1 mentor per SI, 3 mentors total for pilot. will DM mentors after doc is ready.
Priya: also want SI testimonial capture plan during week 2. short interviews + quote capture form.
Diego: will create a Mentor runbook with recording permissions and timezone guidelines.
Aisha: thanks team. I'll share pilot SI list later and create calendar invites. :calendar: Done notes will live in https://redwood.internal/partnerships/si-cohort-2025 (private).
